honest_failures.opportunity_title: Superfund Hazardous Substance Research and Training Program (P42 Clinical Trial Optional)
honest_failures.root_cause: Strong keyword match on 'Superfund' and 'Hazardous Substance', but was designated for university clinical biomedical centers rather than state environmental remediation engineers.
honest_failures.fix_implemented: Added negative weighting for 'Clinical Trial' and enhanced applicant type verification to distinguish university medical researchers from state environmental agency staff.

honest_failures.opportunity_title: Aquifer Resilience and Emerging Solute Transport Modeling
honest_failures.root_cause: Opportunity omitted the popular phrase 'drinking water' and instead used technical hydrogeological terminology ('solute transport'), lowering initial title match score.
honest_failures.fix_implemented: Expanded profile goal synonym dictionary to link 'solute transport', 'per- and polyfluoroalkyl', and 'groundwater hydrology' directly into NC DEQ Goal 1 (Water Quality).

ai_field_notes.where_ai_was_wrong: During initial drafting of summaries, the model hallucinated that NC DEQ had a mandatory 50% state cash match for all federal programs. In reality, state cost-share varies by statutory program (often 0-20%).
ai_field_notes.how_we_caught_it: Spot-checked 5 AI summaries against official Notices of Funding Opportunity (NOFO). Instructed model prompt to strictly cite 'cost sharing: true/false' from Grants.gov synopsis instead of estimating match percentages.
